The '''Core Campaign''' was the military campaign launched by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] to capture the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As a culmination of their multiple campaigns over the last two years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Core Campaign resulted in the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Coruscant, causing the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to effectively flee.

==Prelude==
By the middle of [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the New Republic had encircled the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and was finally, in a position to seize [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from Imperial rule. The New Republic realized the importance of Coruscant beyond its mere designation as "000" in galactic charts. The planet was the most densely-populated [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] in the galaxy and controlled two of the galaxy's five most heavily trafficked [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroutes]]. Possession of the system would massively increase the New Republic's legitimacy. To this end, the New Republic began a complex campaign aimed at isolating Coruscant.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref><ref name="TEA" /> General Carlist Rieekan was one of the principal architects of the plan.<ref name="TLCS" />

==The campaign==
===The feint at Talasea===
{{Main|Battle in the Chorax system|Raid on Talasea}}
Deployed from [[Folor Base]] in the [[Commenor system/Legends|Commenor system]], the New Republic's elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] moved to a new base on the uninhabited world of [[Talasea]]. There they were to begin operations as a feint to draw the Empire away from Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar's]] true target, the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] world [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]], codenamed "Blackmoon".<ref name="XW:RS" /><ref name="TEA" />

En route to [[Talasea base|Talasea Base]], however, Rogue Squadron was coincidentally pulled out of hyperspace in the [[Chorax system/Legends|Chorax system]] by the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]] [[Corusca Rainbow|''Black Asp'']], which was attempting to capture [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik's]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] ship ''[[Pulsar Skate]]''. In the resulting [[Battle in the Chorax system|battle]], the Rogues rescued Terrik, but also allowed the Empire to identify the X-wings as belonging to Rogue Squadron. The [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Kirtan Loor]] was tasked by [[Ysanne Isard]] to locate and destroy the Squadron.<ref name="XW:RS" />

Loor tracked Rogue Squadron to Talasea, and the Squadron only survived the subsequent Imperial [[Raid on Talasea|raid on the planet]] thanks to Admiral [[Devlia]]'s incompetence. Admiral Gial Ackbar swiftly evacuated Talasea and Rogue Squadron was relocated to [[Noquivzor]] after a [[Defense of Vladet|retaliatory raid]] that killed Devlia at [[Vladet]] and forced the Empire to commit numerous resources to rebuilding its headquarters in that sector.<ref name="XW:RS" />

===The battles of Borleias===
{{Main|First Battle of Borleias|Second Battle of Borleias}}
With the Talasea feint a failure, Ackbar devoted all efforts to the capture of Borleias. The planet was a vital stepping stone on the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]] to Coruscant. [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] agents under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Laryn Kre'fey]] had determined from Imperial [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transmissions that the planet was weakly defended. However, the Bothans were unaware that Imperial General [[Evir Derricote]] had secretly increased Borleias' defenses in order to protect his own illegal [[Alderaan Biotics facility]], among other things, drastically increasing the power on the planet's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. Additionally, Derricote had become aware of the Bothans' spying operation and had been feeding them false information for some time.<ref name="XW:RS" />

Additionally, Kirtan Loor had previously identified Borleias as the likely site of a New Republic preparatory attack for the advance on Coruscant. Ysanne Isard sent him to Borleias, and Loor mistakenly believed that she too was aware of his conclusions. In fact, Isard sent Loor only to spy on Derricote, who she believed possessed horticultural and scientific skills that could be developed into a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] against the New Republic. Had Loor shared his theory with Isard, she would have dispatched a greater defense force with more resources to utterly destroy the attacking New Republic forces.<ref name="XW:RS" />

Regardless of Imperial miscommunication, the [[First Battle of Borleias]] was a disaster for the New Republic: the unanticipated strength of the deflector shield meant that Kre'fey's plan to [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombard]] the Biotics facility from orbit was a failure. The New Republic lost two [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], Kre'fey was killed, and Rogue Squadron had to be rescued by General [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] to escape. However, Loor and Isard's miscommunication meant that the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Eviscerator/Legends|''Eviscerator'']] was not in the system during the battle, when it could have destroyed the entire New Republic force.<ref name="XW:RS" />

Several weeks later, the New Republic launched a feint in the [[Venjagga system/Legends|Venjagga system]], targeting [[Jagga II]], which produced missiles for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The attack lured the ''Eviscerator'' away from Borleias, and with an improved plan, Rogue Squadron attacked Borleias again. Hiding behind a [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor shower]] from the planet's moon, Rogue Squadron successfully severed the deflector shield's power conduit. With the cornerstone of their defenses destroyed, the Imperial defense collapsed and the [[Second Battle of Borleias]] was a Republic victory.<ref name="XW:RS" />

===The Liberation of Coruscant===
[[File:RebelVictoryAtCoruscant.jpg|thumb|right|200px|New Republic troops liberate Coruscant.]]
{{Main|Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)}}
With Borleias captured, Admiral Ackbar was now in a position to assault Coruscant directly. However, the capital was protected by a powerful [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]]. Before the attack could begin, the shields would have to fall. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and Rogue Squadron were sent undercover into [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] to sabotage the shield generator. Sixteen of the galaxy's worst criminals, including former [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Fliry Vorru]] and gangster [[Zekka Thyne]] were also freed from the prison colony of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and loosed on Imperial City so that they could create trouble for Imperial authorities.<ref name="XW:WG" />

Meanwhile, Rogue Squadron decided that if they could condense a large amount of water and create a super storm, they could destroy the energy shield protecting Coruscant with lightning strikes. The Rogue operatives hijacked a [[EVS Construction Droid|construction droid]] to take them to the command building. There, they took remote control of one of Coruscant's orbiting [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite|solar mirrors]]. The tightly-focused light beam from the solar mirror rapidly boiled one of the planet's reservoirs. This caused a huge storm and the shields soon collapsed.<ref name="XW:WG" />

With the shields down, a New Republic force led by Admiral Ackbar entered the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]]. This task force easily overwhelmed remaining Imperial force, since Ysanne Isard kept only a few [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to defend the capital world. Very soon, Coruscant was in the hands of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="XW:WG" /><ref name="TEA" />

===Operations against Zsinj===
Concurrent to operations against Coruscant was a series of raids into the New Republic's rear by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], the former [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Quelii Oversector]] who had carved out [[Zsinj's Empire|his own dominion]] after [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] death at Endor. Battles were fought at [[Battle of Mrisst (6 ABY)|Mrisst]] and [[Battle of Noquivzor|Noquivzor]] that cemented Zsinj's growing reputation as a dangerous opponent to the New Republic.<ref name="XW:WG" />

==Aftermath==
After the New Republic had liberated Coruscant, the Empire collapsed and the galaxy entered a transitional period, with many former leaders of the fallen regime becoming independent warlords, of whom Zsinj had emerged as the most dangerous. Isard was not found in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]]. Worse, the planet's [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] population was being killed by an artificial pathogen called the [[Krytos virus]]. The virus was Isard's final attempt to undermine the leadership of the New Republic, and she fled to [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] to continue her struggle. The New Republic government was forced to spend billions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Credits]] on [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] in an effort to treat the plague, which Isard, having maneuvered to be elected [[Chief Operating Officer]] of Thyferra, was able to control. Rogue Squadron resigned their commissions en masse to continue their personal war against Isard, and the so-called "[[Bacta War]]" ended with Isard's defeat at the [[Battle of Thyferra]] and the Republic securing the bacta supply.<ref name="XW:TKT" /><ref name="TEA" />

The Republic would later regret its decision to release criminals on to Coruscant, since they criminals would later resurrect the criminal syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].
